context: Capture the current origin/develop SHA, dispatch nightly.yml on develop, wait for completion without polling beyond the active batch, and inspect exact Windows job conclusions. If a hand-off-owned family remains red, fix it in a dedicated PR before completing this item; unrelated failures must be recorded with evidence and routed without weakening the Windows acceptance criterion.
description: The hand-off's Windows families were fixed across multiple merged PRs, but the latest develop Nightly run 30690807993 predates those merges and still has failing Windows test jobs. Dispatch Nightly Validation from current develop, require both Windows 3.10 and 3.12 test jobs to complete successfully, and inventory any remaining failures with resolved run and job IDs.

anti_patterns.dont: Treat a pre-merge scheduled run as final proof
anti_patterns.instead: Dispatch from the current develop SHA
anti_patterns.why: It does not contain the completed fixes

anti_patterns.dont: Use a literal xargs placeholder inside command substitution
anti_patterns.instead: Resolve run_id and job_id into non-empty variables first
anti_patterns.why: It produced a vacuous zero-failure count

deferrals.reason: Run 30717140915 job 91414534073 failed only test_cooperative_cancel_with_real_set_event_still_cancels: the 0.1s sleeper can complete before the timeout handler inspects future.done() on a loaded runner, leaving the event correctly unset but making the test nondeterministic. This is outside the Windows acceptance criterion and needs a deterministic event-driven test.
deferrals.summary: macOS Nightly cooperative-cancel test races worker completion against timeout classification

preserves.behavior: A green required PR aggregator is not substituted for Nightly Windows proof
No assertion is weakened or test skipped merely to make Nightly green
Run and job IDs are resolved before failure counts are interpreted

verifications.command: run_id=$(gh run list --repo joeharris76/BenchBox --workflow nightly.yml --event workflow_dispatch --branch develop --limit 1 --json databaseId --jq '.[0].databaseId'); test -n "$run_id"; gh run view "$run_id" --repo joeharris76/BenchBox --json status,conclusion --jq 'select(.status=="completed" and .conclusion=="success")' | grep -q success
verifications.expected: passes only for a completed successful current dispatch and fails while the workflow is red or incomplete

verifications.command: run_id=$(gh run list --repo joeharris76/BenchBox --workflow nightly.yml --event workflow_dispatch --branch develop --limit 1 --json databaseId --jq '.[0].databaseId'); test -n "$run_id"; test "$(gh run view "$run_id" --repo joeharris76/BenchBox --json jobs --jq '[.jobs[]|select((.name=="test (windows-latest, 3.10)" or .name=="test (windows-latest, 3.12)") and .conclusion=="success")]|length')" -eq 2
verifications.description: Both Windows interpreter test jobs succeeded
verifications.expected: passes only when both Windows test jobs are green and fails on the pre-fix run
